title: 'BTS: The City Arirang' Las Vegas Festival Officially Opens — Citywide Red Illumination, Arte Museum, Forum Shops Pop-Up
detail: The 'BTS: The City Arirang' Las Vegas citywide festival officially launches on May 20, 2026, running through May 31 — the first activation of 'Global The City 2.0,' described as the largest city-linked K-pop campaign in history. On opening day, Arte Museum Las Vegas (3716 S Las Vegas Blvd) launches a BTS ARIRANG collaborative immersive exhibition running through June 17, with an opening-day Stamp Rally from 10 AM–10 PM PDT. The BTS Pop-Up: ARIRANG at The Forum Shops at Caesars Palace opens exclusively for RSVP holders, selling merchandise available only at this location. The Las Vegas citywide 'ARIRANG Red Illumination' activates on opening day, lighting the Strip, Downtown, and Off-Strip hotels in red — landmarks including the Eiffel Tower at Paris Las Vegas, Luxor Hotel, Mandalay Bay, and the High Roller participate. Airport photo opportunities and BTS welcome messaging launch throughout the Strip. The festival precedes four ARIRANG World Tour shows at Allegiant Stadium (May 23, 24, 27, 28) and runs concurrently with the Las Vegas Sphere Exosphere ARIRANG visuals (launching May 22). The Las Vegas Monorail BTS-themed wrap activation begins May 21, running through June 4. ARMY began converging on Las Vegas from across the US and internationally on opening day, with hotels across the Strip and Convention Center district reporting full occupancy.

media.caption: 'BTS: The City Arirang' Las Vegas festival opens May 20, 2026 — the Las Vegas Strip lights up in ARIRANG red as ARMY arrives

title: 'SWIM' Tops Billboard Global Excl. U.S. for Record 6th Time — Surpasses Taylor Swift's All-Time Mark
detail: BTS's 'SWIM' tops the Billboard Global Excl. U.S. chart for a record sixth time on the chart dated May 20, 2026, surpassing Taylor Swift's previous all-time record for the most No. 1 entries on that chart by a single song. 'SWIM' simultaneously holds No. 2 on the Billboard Global 200 for its third consecutive week at that position (having spent four weeks at No. 1). The chart dominance extends across all 13 tracks of the ARIRANG album, which have remained on both global charts for eight consecutive weeks — itself a K-pop record. On U.S. radio, 'SWIM' charts No. 11 on Pop Airplay, No. 16 on Adult Contemporary, No. 18 on Adult Pop Airplay, and No. 29 on Radio Songs, demonstrating sustained US mainstream radio penetration at the 8-week mark. The record-breaking milestone is reported by STARNEWS Korea, Asia Business Daily, allkpop, and Korea Herald. 'SWIM' is the lead single from the ARIRANG album, released March 20, 2026; the album itself has now spent three consecutive weeks at No. 1 on the Billboard 200, as confirmed by Variety.

media.caption: 'SWIM' tops Billboard Global Excl. US for a record 6th time — surpassing Taylor Swift's all-time mark

title: Jung Kook × Calvin Klein 'CKJK' Collection Launches Retail — Sells Out in 30 Minutes in U.S., 1 Minute in China
detail: The Jung Kook × Calvin Klein 'CKJK' collaborative fashion collection enters retail availability on May 20, 2026, following its online launch at 6 PM EST on May 19. The 20-piece capsule collection (priced $29–$699) sells out across the United States in under 30 minutes. In China, the leather jacket sells out in under one minute. The sellout extends to major markets in Europe, Southeast Asia, and Latin America within hours of the retail launch. The CKJK collection — Jung Kook's first major luxury fashion collaboration — features co-branded underwear, denim, outerwear, and accessories designed with Calvin Klein's minimalist aesthetic. The launch comes while Jung Kook is performing as part of the BTS ARIRANG World Tour, which arrives in Las Vegas for four Allegiant Stadium shows starting May 23. STARNEWS Korea confirms the worldwide sellout on May 21. Fan community frustration surfaces on social media over HYBE announcing a BTS 'SWIM' merchandise drop (via Weverse Shop, May 26) just one day before the CKJK launch, with many ARMY members calling the timing poor.

media.caption: Jung Kook × Calvin Klein 'CKJK' collection sells out in 30 minutes in the US and 1 minute in China on May 20, 2026
